passage:
A walking app promised to plant trees when users reached step goals. Many students downloaded it.
Their science teacher asked them to check how the program worked. Who planted the trees? Where? What species? Were the trees cared for after planting?
Students discovered that some programs were transparent, while others gave little information.
They learned that good environmental action needs more than attractive slogans. Planting a tree is not finished when a photo is posted.
The app encouraged walking, which was positive. But students learned to ask for evidence. Green promises should grow roots in reality.
